cmd: cd /app && ls -la && which pmars && pmars --help 2>&1 | head -30
ls warriors/ && cat warriors/stone.red
cat warriors/paper.red warriors/vampire.red warriors/snake.red warriors/g2-clear.red
read_file warriors/paper.red
read_file warriors/vampire.red
read_file warriors/snake.red
cat /app/warriors/paper.red
cat /app/warriors/snake.red
head -60 /app/warriors/snake.red; echo ===; wc -l /app/warriors/*.red

cat > /app/my_warrior.red << 'EOF'
;redcode-94
;name Combo
;author AI
;strategy Fast bomber + spl0 decoy + spl1 self-copy

        org start

start   spl 1             ; split: one copy handles bomber
        spl 0             ; decoy for replicators/tracers
        spl 0

bomb    mov *p, >t        ; throw DAT bombs
        djn bomb, }p

p       dat 1, 1
t       dat 1, 1

        end start
EOF
pmars -b -r 100 -f /app/my_warrior.red /app/warriors/stone.red | tail -5
for o in paper vampire snake g2-clear; do echo "== $o"; pmars -b -r 100 -f /app/my_warrior.red /app/warriors/$o.red 2>/dev/null | grep Results; done
